scope: Controlled-state A/B comparisons of prediction, stage share, subdeadline, snapshots, ordered frame membership, admission, preemption, routing, finish and KV accounting.
If and only if controlled semantics pass, one A/B public-chain0 end-to-end pair on physical GPU0.
No C run and no performance matrix.
A_identity: Official native AsyncLLMEngine and vendored vLLM executor with the stage2 matched resource configuration.
B_identity: The same official server, RequestInfo, SequenceGroup, GraphMatchContext, SLOScheduler and output processing, with the study-owned asynchronous PyTorch executor and explicit KV ledger. B is not a GMAX-core-only adapter.
shared_backend_for_future_C: The exact B executor, explicit KV ledger, model, prompt tokens, generation path and audit interfaces are the required backend for any future C. C is not authorized now.

public_input.semantics: fixed public prompt/graph replay, not live online-agent behavior

matched_resources.cpu_block_rule: floor(swap_space_bytes / official CacheEngine.get_cache_block_size) for both A and B

controlled_fixtures: chain0 stage0/stage1 prediction and graph state
four-group ordered official frame with a nontrivial waiting/running boundary
small-cache admission and preemption with swap-out/swap-in witnesses
single-engine routing, finish status and KV release

semantic_tolerances.snapshot: exact value and version equality; prediction callback updates request_info only
semantic_tolerances.admission_and_preemption: exact queue, request-ID and preemption-mode transitions
semantic_tolerances.finish: exact sequence status, finish reason and freed request IDs
semantic_tolerances.kv: identical official block accounting; B token ledger must explain every computed/GPU/host/recomputed/swapped token without silent LRU eviction

metrics: strict chain SLO and same-ID stage/call completion
collection/stage/request latency and TTFT/TPOT where available
output token counts and stop reasons
official KV blocks and B GPU/host/recompute/swap token ledger
material_harness_difference: Any strict chain-SLO or same-ID completion disagreement is material and blocks mechanism interpretation.
Relative collection-latency difference above 10% is a material harness warning, not a statistical equivalence test.
Output-token or stop-reason disagreement is reported as a generation/harness boundary and blocks an unqualified A≈B claim.
AB_end_to_end.interpretation: One qualification block only; no significance, general superiority or C mechanism claim.
